creator: Alexander Terp
description: A worker ran `muster msg post --to lily -` meaning a private handoff; it posted into a round-wide group both were in, one the owner had reserved for announcements. The destination is said only after the post is written. Options: a direct-message form of `--to` that never reuses a group with other members, or refusing when `--to` would pick a group with others in it and asking for `--group`. From tooling feedback a_2xvFLXWI3.
title: msg post --to can post into a shared group the sender meant to keep out of
